name: bing-ads-impression-share-and-auction-insights
description: Use for "how do I stack up against competitors on Bing", "what's my share of voice on Microsoft Ads", "am I showing at the top of the page on Bing", "am I losing Microsoft Ads auctions to competitors", "why is my Bing click share falling", "is someone bidding on my brand on Bing", "which Microsoft Ads keywords am I being outranked on" — even when the user never says "competition". This is the account's own position in the auction — share won, top-of-page, click share — not a list of who it's up against. Microsoft Ads (Bing) only.
